reason: In test_state_results_multi_group (tests/sentry/workflow_engine/processors/test_detector.py:206), the patch checks Kafka publishes with `assert_has_calls(..., any_order=True)` and never checks `call_count`, so the test still passes if there are extra or duplicate `produce_occurrence_to_kafka` calls.
